title: Blind adjudication judgment (one presentation order)
description: preferred picks return A or B; there is no tie. why must be at least 60 characters and cite the evidence paths opened (adjudicate.py enforces the length; it is not a schema keyword because Codex strict output does not accept minLength). leak is true, with leak_text quoting what was found, when the input shows reviewer identity (adjudication-prompt.md, the leak check); the other fields are then placeholders and adjudicate.py records the judgment as missing (failure leak). Otherwise leak is false and leak_text is empty.
